newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London mixed, Intel slips.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London mixed, Intel slips.

text.p: U.S. stocks were mixed in London on Monday and brokers here were expecting Wall Street to open steady to weaker after Friday's technology-led surge.
Shares in Intel Corp were down $1/2 at $104-7/8 after having jumped $5-1/2 in New York on Friday ahead of the release of the company's third quarter results today.
"It's just nervous profit-taking," said one broker of Intel's decline. "Intel is releasing its results today and there's no room for disappointment."
Intel, an industry bellwether, is expected to report third quarter profits of $1.25 per share, up from $1.02 year ago.

Shares in automobile makers were mixed ahead of the release of their results this week. Ford Motor Co and Chrylser Corp were each up $1/4 in London to $32-3/8 and $32, respectively. But shares in General Motors Corp, under the weight of growing labour problems in Canada, were off $3/8 at $49-3/4.

Shares in Archer Daniels Midland Co rose $1/4 to $20-7/8, a new high, after the Wall Street Journal said the company was expected to plead guilty to two criminal charges and pay a total $100 million in fines after a federal investigation into price fixing in the sale of agricultural products.
"This has been haunting them for a long time," the broker said. "I think people will be relieved to get this out of the way."
In other trading, the December S&P 500 index futures contract slipped 0.20 points to 705.70 by 1047 GMT on Globex.
The U.S. Treasuries market will be closed today for the U.S. Columbus Day holiday, but U.S. stock exchanges will be open during regular hours today.
No U.S. economic data are due for release.
